description.value: Hotel Viewmont Restaurant is the sit-down dining room of Hotel Viewmont in Logan Lake, BC, serving freshly prepared meals in a cozy atmosphere with patio seating. The hotel has operated since 1995 and sits in the Thompson Highlands, a natural waypoint for cyclists crossing between Merritt and the Okanagan. The property is pet-friendly and offers a shuttle to Kamloops Airport, making it a practical overnight base as well as a meal stop.

address.value: 19 Apex Dr, Logan Lake, BC V0K 1W0
